Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the driver was changing lanes. Complaints centered on neck
and low back pain with associated muscle tightness and reduced range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the
reported crash, and the presentation fits the expected pattern for this type of impact. Imaging and physical examination findings
clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar regions. No prior injury to these body areas is known from the patient
history reviewed at intake. Care included 15 visits consisting of manual therapy, targeted home exercise instruction, and
as-needed analgesic management. Treatment followed a typical course, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and
function returned. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At the
most recent evaluation, the patient reported mild residual stiffness and was discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions
to return if symptoms recur.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
